title: Add README as central hub for OctoAcme process docs
head: add-readme-for-process-docs
body:
This pull request adds docs/README.md to serve as the central entry point for OctoAcme's project management process documentation.

- Adds a concise overview of OctoAcme's project management lifecycle and key principles
- Adds a 3–4 paragraph summary of core workflows, communication strategies, personas/roles, and QA practices
- Adds an index linking to all existing process documents in the docs/ folder for quick navigation

Closes #2
